fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Video length in seconds. The output can run up to about 0.7 s longer than requested. Use at least 2 s with target_audio_url.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: The native generation resolution, or 1080P latent refinement from a native 768P source.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.

fields.name: prompt_expansion_mode
fields.title: Prompt Expansion Mode
fields.description: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. 'disabled' skips prompt expansion. 'balanced' returns in about a second. 'quality' spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt.
